headline: RITES Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - RITES Limited has informed the Exchange about  that the Board took note that the proposal for formation of JV with NICC Infrastructure Construction LLC and contribution of capital therein is not materializing, this is in…
detail: General Updates - RITES Limited has informed the Exchange about  that the Board took note that the proposal for formation of JV with NICC Infrastructure Construction LLC and contribution of capital therein is not materializing, this is in continuation to our intimation dated June 25, 2026 w.r.t approval for formation and investment of capital in JV with NICC Infrastructure Construction LLC.
